about_short_description.short_description: Dojah is an AI powered fraud prevention and KYC Platform to identity for growth, security, and compliance in the businesses.

product.name: Identity Hub
product.description: An API-first identity verification platform for creating customizable KYC and KYB workflows using government ID, document, biometric, address, liveness, phone, email, financial, and device checks.

product.name: Anti-Fraud Hub
product.description: A fraud prevention platform that combines rule-based detection, real-time transaction screening, behavioral analysis, threat intelligence, and risk workflows to identify suspicious users and activity.

product.name: EasyOnboard
product.description: A no-code customer onboarding tool for building branded verification flows with configurable identity, biometric, financial, AML, address, and telecommunications checks.

product.name: EasyDetect
product.description: A configurable, no-code fraud detection tool that uses rules, events, transaction monitoring, behavioral signals, and risk scoring to flag suspicious activity throughout the customer journey.

product.name: AML and PEP Screening
product.description: A compliance screening service that checks customers against sanctions and politically exposed person watchlists to assess money-laundering and financial-crime risk.

product.name: NDPC Compliance Support
product.description: A professional service supporting Nigerian businesses with data-protection registration, compliance audit return preparation, documentation, readiness reviews, and ongoing advisory.
